sub_graphs.title: Prague: ALT_BN128 Pairing Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the bilinear pairing verification process

nodes.label: Pairing Input Received
nodes.description: Input data received for pairing check, must be multiple of 192 bytes

nodes.label: Pairing Length Valid
nodes.description: Input length verified as multiple of 192 bytes

nodes.label: Pairing Element Valid
nodes.description: One 192-byte element (G1 + G2 pair) has been validated

nodes.label: Pairing Accumulated
nodes.description: All pairings computed and accumulated

nodes.label: Pairing Result True
nodes.description: Accumulated pairing equals identity, output 1

nodes.label: Pairing Result False
nodes.description: Accumulated pairing does not equal identity, output 0

nodes.label: Check 192-Byte Multiple
nodes.description: Verify input length is divisible by 192

nodes.label: Parse G1+G2 Pair
nodes.description: Extract 64-byte G1 point and 128-byte G2 point from 192-byte chunk

nodes.label: Validate Subgroup Order
nodes.description: Check that points do not have order equal to curve order (subgroup check)

nodes.label: Compute Bilinear Pairing
nodes.description: Compute e(G1, G2) pairing and accumulate result

nodes.label: Check Final Result
nodes.description: Check if accumulated pairing result equals the identity element

ambiguities.text: The exact behavior when input is shorter than required (e.g., less than 64 bytes for G1) is described as triggering InvalidParameter which converts to OutOfGasError.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any invalid parameter condition (wrong length, invalid field element, point not on curve) results in OutOfGasError and consumes all provided gas.

ambiguities.text: The description 'validates that neither point has order matching the curve order' for pairing is unclear about what exactly is being checked.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a subgroup membership check to prevent invalid curve attacks, ensuring points are in the correct subgroup of the curve.

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying elliptic curve arithmetic library (used for point addition, multiplication, and pairing) is correct and free of implementation bugs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect cryptographic operations could allow forged proofs, invalid signatures, or other cryptographic attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find collisions or exploit weaknesses in the ALT_BN128 curve that would allow invalid proofs to pass verification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cryptographic attacks could compromise zkSNARK verification and other privacy/validity proofs.

implicit_assumptions.description: The field modulus and curve parameters are correctly defined and consistent across all implementations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent curve parameters could lead to consensus failures or exploitable differences between implementations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas costs (150, 6000, 34000*n+45000) accurately reflect the computational complexity and prevent DoS attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced operations could be exploited for denial-of-service attacks against nodes.
